first_end.mechanism: modification/supersession by restatement: Schedule B, Subdivision IV, paragraph 1 (the paragraph EO 2112 added) amended by striking out instructors in flying, student instructors in flying, aviation mechanicians and inspectors ... 'in the aviation section of the Signal Corps' (placed in the competitive service), restated as '1. Aeronautical engineers, aeronautical mechanical engineers, aeronautical chemists, and aeronautical mechanical draftsmen.' without the Aviation Section limitation. The clause as 2112 wrote it (including instructors in flying and aviation mechanicians, limited to the Aviation Section) therefore ended 1919-04-14; a residual noncompetitive class (aeronautical engineers etc., unlimited) continues in restated form - its later fate is for savings_residuals / needs a later Schedule B compilation.
